description: This file defines the ITransactionAgent interface in the Orleans.Transactions namespace, which provides methods for starting, resolving, and aborting transactions within the Orleans framework. It is used by silos and activations to interact with the transaction system.
external_methods: Task<(TransactionalStatus Status, Exception exception)> Resolve(TransactionInfo transactionInfo)

classes.name: ITransactionAgent
classes.description: Interface for transaction management in Orleans, allowing starting, resolving, and aborting transactions.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a new transaction with specified read-only status and timeout.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a transaction, either committing or aborting it, returning status and exception info.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a specified transaction without throwing exceptions.

calls: Task<(TransactionalStatus Status, Exception exception)> Resolve(TransactionInfo transactionInfo)
